title: Golden Brown-Butter Skillet Cornbread
summary: Butter is browned in the preheated skillet, whisked with buttermilk and eggs, folded into cornmeal, flour and leaveners, and baked in the same hot pan until golden.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.text: Put the empty cast-iron pan in the oven and heat to 220 °C (200 °C fan).

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, bicarbonate and salt together.

steps.title: Brown the butter
steps.text: Take out the hot pan, add the butter and swirl 1-2 minutes until it foams and smells nutty. Pour all but 1 tbsp into a bowl.

steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.text: Whisk the buttermilk and eggs into the browned butter, pour into the dry ingredients and fold until just combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Scrape into the hot pan and bake 18-22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cool 5 minutes, cut into 8 wedges and serve warm with butter.

tips: The batter should sizzle as it hits the pan; that is what makes the crisp crust.
Stop folding as soon as the flour disappears for a tender crumb.
Use oven gloves throughout: the cast-iron handle gets very hot.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Warm through before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
